b: The duo's 1994 debut album has been remastered and will be newly released with three extra tracks
Main's 1994 debut album Motion Pool is being reissued.

The record, which followed an initial series of EPs from Robert Hampson and Scott Dowson's project, has been remastered for the updated edition, which will also take in three additional tracks from the era of the original album's production. It will be a double-vinyl release.

Blending Hampson and Dowson's history with post-rock and drone music as part of Loop, Motion Pool saw the duo push their sound further into the ambient and abstract territory that they sought to explore more deeply together as Main.
